about.text: An Argentine hard cheese made in 6.8 kg wheels by Italian immigrants as a local answer to Parmigiano Reggiano, ripened about six months and grated over pasta.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: Wheels of about 6.8 kg, smaller than Parmigiano Reggiano
Italian immigrants to Argentina wanting a Parmigiano-like cheese; the name is the diminutive of Reggio
